Set the default editor for opening files from Remotion Studio. Available editors: `vscode, cursor, windsurf, zed, vscodium, webstorm, sublime-text`.

## CLI flag

Use `--editor` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                               | Flag               |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------------ |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio) | `--editor <value>` |

## API and configuration references

Follow a reference for the parameter name, default value, and examples in that API or configuration method.

| Reference                                           | Name                        |
| --------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------- |
| [Configuration file](/docs/config#setdefaulteditor) | `Config.setDefaultEditor()` |
